entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Hewitt–Sperry Automatic Airplane was a project undertaken during World War I to develop a flying bomb, or pilotless aircraft capable of carrying explosives to its target. It is considered by some to be a precursor of the cruise missile. It was funded by the US Navy and created by Elmer Sperry.
